papers.title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract: The rapid development of large language models and multimodal large language models has accelerated the emergence of proactive agents capable of operating everyday tools and assisting users in real-world environments. However, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate such agents effectively, as they often rely on sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation paradigms. Moreover, their scenario-based task taxonomies mix multiple model capabilities within the same task category, making it diff
papers.llm_reason: 针对主动式 Agent（proactive agents）在真实环境中的评测提出统一基准，解决现有 benchmark 依赖沙箱环境和单轮评测范式的核心痛点。工程价值极高：Agent 评测是当前最稀缺的基础设施之一，真实环境多轮交互的评测设计直接可用于自研 Agent 系统的回归测试和质量门禁。任务分类法将多种模型能力解耦到不同任务类别，方法论上对 Agent 架构设计有参考意义。证据上声称有实验验证但暂无公开代码/数据集（code_url/benchmark_url 均为空），可复现性待核验。综合判定为即时价值——评测框架设计可立即借鉴，任务分类法可转化为内部 Agent 测试用例模板。

papers.title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
papers.abstract: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and
papers.llm_reason: 提出无需 SVD、无状态、不修改架构的训练时低秩正则化方法（SLORR），直接解决神经网络压缩的核心难题——现代模型对激进低秩分解不友好。工程价值明确：stateless 和无额外可训练参数的设计降低了实现复杂度和显存开销，可在现有训练管线中以正则项形式低成本接入。与 LoRA、量化等压缩技术形成互补。证据上暂无公开代码（code_url 为空），但方法描述清晰、实验声称验证了精度保持，工程可试点。综合判定为即时价值——方法可直接实现最小验证。

papers.title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
papers.abstract: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning. However, existing video generators are primarily trained on general video corpora, still lacking diverse supervision and dedicated designs for CoF reasoning. To add
papers.llm_reason: 提出 Chain-of-Frame (CoF) 推理范式——通过时序连接的视频帧序列展开推理过程，区别于 Chain-of-Thought 的文本推理路径。理论贡献新颖：将推理能力从语言模态扩展到视觉时序模态，为多模态推理开辟新方向。工程实践层面的价值在于视频生成模型作为推理引擎的范式探索，可能与世界模型和具身智能形成交叉。但当前处于早期研究阶段，推理质量和效率的实验证据尚待核验（无公开代码），距离工程落地较远。综合判定为趋势价值——理论方向值得关注，需持续跟踪开源和后续工作。

papers.title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
papers.abstract: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. papers.llm_reason: 提出 IdeaGene 框架和 IG-Bench，将科学论文表示为最小可组合的思想基因组（idea genes），评测 AI 在科学谱系推理和谱系驱动的创意生成上的能力。理论框架新颖：将生物基因组学概念迁移到科学思想演化分析，提供了结构化的创意继承与重组模型。工程价值中等：benchmark 和 IdeaGene 框架可转化为 AI 辅助科研工具的评测资产，谱系推理方法可启发知识图谱和文献分析系统的设计。但领域偏向科学计量学，与核心 Agent/LLM 工程栈的直接相关性有限。综合判定为趋势价值——框架设计有启发意义，适合作为跨领域 benchmark 观察。

papers.title: Score Accuracy Along the Forward Diffusion Does Not Certify Numerical Stability in Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract: Score matching controls average error under the forward marginals, but a discretized reverse-time sampler evaluates the learned score along its own trajectory. We show that small forward-marginal error does not guarantee numerical stability. We construct a single smooth score field with arbitrarily small forward-marginal $L^2$ error. papers.llm_reason: 通过构造性证明揭示扩散模型的一个根本性理论盲区：前向边缘分布上的 score 误差小，并不能保证逆向采样过程的数值稳定性。构造了一个前向边缘误差任意小但逆向采样轨迹发散的反例。理论贡献扎实（SDE 非爆炸性、各阶矩存在、路径空间全变差接近），对扩散模型训练和采样的工程实践有直接警示意义：仅优化前向 score 精度不足以保证采样质量。证据强度高（严格的数学构造和证明），但属于理论分析而非即用型方法，工程上的可操作性在于提供了新的评估维度。综合判定为趋势价值——理论洞察重要，需在自研扩散模型管线中加入轨迹稳定性检查。

papers.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation

papers.title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
papers.abstract: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. papers.abstract: In this study, we present a large-scale descriptive analysis of the use of an AI-based learning assistant (Syntea) in higher education. papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction Meets Network Science: Sensemaking on UMAP's kNN Graph
